name: Kashima (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kashima town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing the character 島.
history: Municipal flag of Kashima, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1968.

features.role: Kashima town emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing the character 島
